ui_state.heading: THE 8 INVIOLABLE LAWS
steps: 1. Bilateral agreements fail without central clearing and daily margin mechanics.
2. Futures price is determined by financing cost and storage, never subjective future price speculation.
3. Linear tools (futures/swaps) lock in price but forfeit all favorable upside.
4. Derivative value depends on continuous dynamic replication, completely independent of expected stock return.
5. Directional correctness is meaningless if theta decay and vega collapse outpace delta gains.
6. Constant volatility is a mathematical fiction; tail risk and crashophobia command persistent implied volatility premia.

2. Futures price is determined by financing cost and storage, never subjective future price speculation.
3. Linear tools (futures/swaps) lock in price but forfeit all favorable upside.
4. Derivative value depends on continuous dynamic replication, completely independent of expected stock return.
5. Directional correctness is meaningless if theta decay and vega collapse outpace delta gains.
6. Constant volatility is a mathematical fiction; tail risk and crashophobia command persistent implied volatility premia.
